etymology.historical_story: Clariss is attested as a personal name in a Malaysian university publication. That establishes actual name use, but it does not establish a Malay lexical meaning or a particular bearer’s naming history. Similarity to Clara, Clarice or Clarissa alone cannot settle the origin of this exact occurrence. Preserve the spelling and confirm pronunciation with the bearer. [Attestation](https://www.monash.edu.my/news-and-events/trending/path-to-research-success)

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 称呼时采用本人认可的姓名与读音；正式场合根据已知身份选用称谓，不凭名字推断性别、宗教或族群。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 正文中的人名应大写为 Clariss。登记、证书及邮件中保留原拼写，不擅自改成 Clarice 或 Clarissa，也不把推测的词源含义当作名字译名。
